description:
The MCP envelope's isError remains authoritative. Terminal Run failures
are successful observations, not `ToolFailure` values.
title: ToolOutput

retriever_statuses.description: The retrievers whose results may be missing; absent when none are.

call_path.description:
`coral.providers.<namespace>.…` for a provider tool,
`coral.functions.…` for a Saved Function.

signature_line.description:
The callable's input members one level deep; a provider tool's result
data types by name, an unnamed object as `{…}`; a Saved Function's
result members one level deep. At most 512 UTF-8 bytes.

description_snippet.description:
At most 512 UTF-8 bytes of the description, around the first matched
term; `…` marks cut text.

guidance_snippet.description: Present only when a query term matched the guidance.

matched_tags.description: The tags a query term matched; absent when none did.

matched_inputs.description:
The arguments a query term matched that the signature line does not
show; absent when there are none.

hints.description: Present only when the Provider declared a hint.

approval_required.description: Present, and true, only when a person must approve each call.

deprecated.description: Present, and true, only when the provider tool is deprecated.

SearchHit.description:
One Search Hit. Call a read from it when its signature line is complete:
no cut marker (`…`) and no type named in its input that the line does not
show. Describe first otherwise, and before a write.

Hints.description:
Effect hints the Provider declared. An absent field is undeclared, not a
protocol default.

RetrieverState.description:
- `partial`: some Providers or Saved Functions are not indexed yet, or
  failed; results may be missing.
- `error`: the retriever could not rank; its results are missing.

Retry shortly or list without a query.

trace_id.description:
The W3C trace identifier of this tool call. Give it to the operator
to find the call in Coral's telemetry. It grants no authority.
